description: Triage incoming support tickets by category, severity, and routing.

steps.description: Classify incoming tickets by category and subcategory.

inputs.name: category-definitions
inputs.desc: Supported categories (bug, feature request, billing, how-to)

outputs.name: classified-tickets
outputs.desc: Tickets tagged with category and subcategory

outputs.name: classification-confidence
outputs.desc: Confidence scores for each classification

process: Read each ticket subject and body.
Match against category definitions using keyword and intent analysis.
Assign category, subcategory, and confidence score.
Flag low-confidence tickets for manual review.

steps.description: Assess severity and business impact of each ticket.

outputs.name: scored-tickets
outputs.desc: Tickets with severity and impact scores

outputs.name: critical-alerts
outputs.desc: Tickets flagged as critical for immediate attention

process: Evaluate each ticket against the severity matrix.
Score impact based on number of users affected and business function.
Flag critical tickets for immediate escalation.
Attach severity and impact scores to each ticket.

steps.description: Route tickets to the correct team or support tier.

inputs.name: routing-rules
inputs.desc: Rules mapping categories and severities to teams

outputs.name: routed-tickets
outputs.desc: Tickets assigned to teams with SLA timers

outputs.name: routing-exceptions
outputs.desc: Tickets that could not be auto-routed

process: Apply routing rules based on category, severity, and customer tier.
Set SLA response and resolution timers per the SLA policy.
Assign to the team queue with the shortest wait time.
Log routing exceptions for manual assignment.

steps.description: Send acknowledgment messages to customers with expected response times.

inputs.name: routed-tickets
inputs.desc: Tickets with team assignments and SLA timers

outputs.name: acknowledged-tickets
outputs.desc: Tickets with acknowledgment sent

outputs.name: acknowledgment-log
outputs.desc: Record of all acknowledgments sent

process: Select the acknowledgment template matching the ticket category.
Insert the expected response time from the SLA timer.
Send the acknowledgment to the customer.
Log the acknowledgment timestamp.

steps.description: Produce the triaged ticket queue report with distribution metrics.

outputs.name: triage-report
outputs.desc: Summary of triaged tickets by category, severity, and team

outputs.name: exception-list
outputs.desc: List of unrouted tickets needing attention

process: Count tickets by category, severity, and assigned team.
Calculate average triage time.
List all routing exceptions with reasons.
Produce the triage queue report.

Analyze customer sentiment in recent messages.
Identify repeat contacts on the same issue.
Flag tickets meeting any escalation trigger.

outputs.desc: Tickets assigned to higher-tier agents

outputs.name: escalation-briefs
outputs.desc: Context briefs for receiving agents

process: Determine the target tier based on escalation type.
Compile the ticket history into a brief for the receiving agent.
Assign the ticket to the target tier queue.
Notify the receiving agent with the brief.

outputs.name: resolution-log
outputs.desc: Record of actions taken and resolution details

outputs.name: customer-updates
outputs.desc: Updates sent to the customer during escalation

process: Monitor each escalated ticket for progress updates.
Send periodic status updates to the customer.
Record all actions taken by the handling agent.
Close the escalation when the issue is resolved.

steps.description: Review completed escalations to identify patterns and improvements.

outputs.name: escalation-report
outputs.desc: Analysis of escalation patterns and root causes

outputs.name: improvement-recommendations
outputs.desc: Suggested changes to reduce future escalations

process: Categorize escalations by root cause.
Calculate average resolution time by escalation type.
Identify recurring patterns that could be prevented.
Produce the escalation review report with recommendations.

Send surveys at each trigger point per the sampling plan.

outputs.desc: Aggregate and segmented scores with trends

outputs.desc: Themes from verbatim comments ranked by frequency

Analyze verbatim comments for recurring themes.
Identify drivers of high and low scores.

outputs.desc: Example utterances for each intent

Group into distinct intents.
Rank intents by frequency and resolution complexity.

Design fallback responses for unrecognized inputs.

Run sample conversations through each flow.
